question: What happens when initiation destroys personal ignorance but full manifestation is delayed?
premises: Initiation and related means can destroy personal ignorance.
Even then, the corresponding knowledge may not be fully manifest immediately.
That knowledge becomes clearly manifest at the end of that body.
inference: Therefore initiation can remove personal ignorance while its full fruit becomes explicit at bodily death.
plain_english: Although personal ignorance may be destroyed by initiation and the like, that knowledge becomes clearly manifest at the end of that body.
